english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a reply or response to someone.
Use this for a reply to a message, email, or online comment.

examples.english: I still haven't received your response.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 sau1 dou2 nei5 ge3 wui4 fuk1

examples.english: I still haven't received your email reply.
examples.traditional: 我仲未收到你個電郵回覆。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 sau1 dou2 nei5 go3 din6 jau4 wui4 fuk1
